paper: Liu et al., PLOS ONE 17(1):e0263359 (2022) — MIC of olive leaf extract against L. monocytogenes F2365
quoted_basis: eight OLE concentrations (128.0, 64.0, 32.0, 16.0, 8.0, 4.0, 2.0, and 1.0 mg/ml) were generated by two-fold serial dilutions using BHI broth
Fifty microliters (50 uL) of OLE at each concentration and 50 uL of diluted L. monocytogenes F2365 overnight culture, total 100 uL, were mixed into each well of the plate
Eight replicates (on the plate) were set up for each OLE concentration condition
PC, NC, and OLE stand for the positive control (L. monocytogenes overnight culture), the negative control (BHI broth only), and OLE only
